news_items.headline: Arm Holdings Has Doubled in 2026 — outpacing Synopsys, Cadence, and Qualcomm
news_items.summary: ARM is up 102% YTD through May 18, doubling in under five months and outperforming chip-IP peers Synopsys, Cadence, and Qualcomm.

news_items.headline: Arm stock climbs 3.73% as upcoming earnings report fuels optimism
news_items.summary: ARM shares rose 3.73% to $223.15 on bullish momentum ahead of the next earnings catalyst, with traders citing AI infrastructure optimism.

news_items.headline: Bernstein initiates Arm Holdings at Outperform with $300 price target
news_items.summary: Bernstein began coverage of ARM at Outperform with a $300 price target, citing AGI CPU demand and royalty growth.

news_items.headline: Arm shares rise as AI-infrastructure optimism and price-target hikes stay in focus ahead of earnings
news_items.summary: ARM advanced on AI-infrastructure optimism with multiple sell-side price-target hikes keeping focus on the upcoming earnings print.

news_items.headline: FTC opens antitrust probe into Arm's licensing practices
news_items.summary: The U.S. FTC opened an antitrust investigation into Arm Holdings' chip-IP licensing practices, creating regulatory overhang on the business model.

news_items.headline: Arm AGI CPU demand exceeds $2B for FY27-FY28; supply gap of ~$1B flagged
news_items.summary: Arm reported AGI CPU customer demand above $2B for fiscal 2027-2028, more than double launch projections; however supply chain initially sized for ~$1B leaves an unmet supply gap in wafers, memory, packaging and test capacity.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Bernstein initiated at Outperform with $300 PT (2026-05-18). Per 40-analyst panel, consensus Buy with 12-mo PT $230.92 (+3.48% from current); per 23-analyst panel, 35% Strong Buy, 48% Buy, 13% Hold.

earnings_context.notes: Last quarter (Q4 FY26) was record: revenue $1.49B (+20% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $0.60 record, FY26 EPS $1.77. Data center royalty more than doubled YoY; license revenue +29% to $819M, royalty +11% to $671M. Street expects continued AGI CPU ramp and data center AI royalty acceleration.
